Read a description of a situation. Then write an e-mail about the situation. You will have 9 minutes. You should aim to write at 50-120 words. Write using complete sentences.
ITEM TEXT
Your
company
is
trying
to
save
energy
,
and
you
want
to
write
an
email
to
make
some
suggestions
to
the
manager
Mrs
Smith
about
energy
reduction
.
You
should
write
between
80
and
120
words
.
Your
ideas
must
come
from
the
following
three
themes
:
1
.
Turning
off
the
lights
;
2
.
Shutting
down
computers
;
3
.
Heating
and
air
conditioning
.
